rationale: This mutation eliminates the cash deficit by strictly capping the workforce at 7 hands to prevent massive wage drain on the 14-plot maximum, correcting the over-hiring (11 hands) that starved late-game capital in previous generations. It elevates Oracle Frontrun to Priority 3 to dump vulnerable commodities before opponent gluts, lowers the capital velocity shed threshold to 25% for continuous liquidity, and reorders farm execution to prioritize planting and watering above shed drop-offs, completely eliminating transit waste and maximizing hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding.
